messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Shiny 0.4.0
parts:
Hi everyone -

Shiny 0.4.0 has been released on CRAN, and we've posted about it on the blog:
  http://blog.rstudio.org/2013/02/22/shiny-0-4-0-now-available/

As usual, it may take a little while for it to propagate to your local mirror.

-Winston

messages.author: 81b6b3d7dfea88a5
messages.subject: Re: Shiny 0.4.0
parts:
Hi Winston,

I just tried updating to 0.4 on windows firstly from CRAN and then from RStudio, and although it says it is v0.4.0 it appears not to be because I'm not getting any of the warnings about the API changes and starting to change to renderUI in my code gave me this :

Error in serverFunc(input = .createReactiveValues(shinyapp$session, readonly = TRUE),  : 
  could not find function "renderUI"

packageDescription('shiny') gives :
Package: shiny
Type: Package
Title: Web Application Framework for R
Version: 0.4.0
Date: 2013-01-23
Author: RStudio, Inc.
Maintainer: Winston Chang <win...@rstudio.com>
Description: Shiny makes it incredibly easy to build interactive web applications with R.
          Automatic "reactive" binding between inputs and outputs and extensive pre-built
          widgets make it possible to build beautiful, responsive, and powerful applications
          with minimal effort.
License: GPL-3
Depends: R (>= 2.14.1)
Imports: stats, tools, utils, datasets, methods, websockets (>= 1.1.6), caTools, RJSONIO,
          xtable, digest
Suggests: markdown, Cairo, testthat
URL: http://www.rstudio.com/shiny/
BugReports: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues
Collate: 'map.R' 'utils.R' 'tar.R' 'timer.R' 'tags.R' 'cache.R' 'react.R' 'reactives.R'
          'fileupload.R' .....
Packaged: 2013-02-21 22:58:53 UTC; winston
NeedsCompilation: no
Repository: CRAN
Date/Publication: 2013-02-22 08:23:38
Built: R 2.15.2; ; 2013-02-22 10:30:16 UTC; windows

I'll try installing from github, but need to update my RTools first, and thought you'd like to know.

Thanks,
Andy
